kinematic_definitions.sternoclavicular_elevation: rotation of clavicle superiorly relative to thorax, not posterior rotation about long axis
kinematic_definitions.sternoclavicular_retraction: posterior motion of lateral clavicle relative to thorax
kinematic_definitions.sternoclavicular_posterior_axial_rotatio: rotation about clavicle longitudinal axis, NOT scapular tilt or SC elevation
kinematic_definitions.acromioclavicular_posterior_tilt: scapular posterior tilt RELATIVE TO CLAVICLE, not SC elevation
kinematic_definitions.humerothoracic_elevation: arm elevation relative to thorax, distinct from glenohumeral elevation relative to scapula

sources.title: Three-dimensional clavicular motion during arm elevation: reliability and descriptive data
limits: Ranges are reported maxima across tested tasks/subjects and not a single physiological hard bound
PubMed abstract lacks source angle-by-angle trajectories and per-subject distributions
Sensor-on-skin methodological uncertainty differs from transcortical pins
Not a character-specific 1.82-m male model or loaded exercise measurement

sources.title: Motion of the shoulder complex during multiplanar humeral elevation
sources.method: transcortical bone pins and electromagnetic motion tracking of clavicle, scapula and humerus
limits: 31 degrees refers to SC POSTERIOR LONG-AXIS ROTATION, never to elevation
19 degrees refers to AC scapular posterior tilt, never to clavicular elevation
Numerical SC elevation-vs-humerothoracic tables/curve not recovered from primary abstract
Bone pin motion axes and sign mapping must be matched to current HGPT thorax before any fitting

sources.title: Shoulder Impingement: Biomechanical Considerations in Rehabilitation

measures.descriptive_statement: typically below 10 degrees during healthy arm elevation

limits: Secondary review statement, not a primary subject-specific maximum
Not consistent as a universal cap with 2004 source reported 11–15 degree maxima
Cannot be combined with generic model linear regression without frame and population matching

existing_model_template.normalized_angle_convention: model OpenSim axial geometry, not automatically converted to HGPT anatomically verified frames
